profile_projection.exact_rule: - Before normal edits, inspect owner, tests, and minimum consumer.
- Stop unless inspection proves behavior/owner/reuse/non-proximity placement/edit scope.

required_terms: observable normal, invalid, boundary, and forbidden outcomes
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Before implementation, define acceptance's observable normal, invalid, boundary, and forbidden outcomes plus validation signal; stop if unverifiable.
- Before bugfixes, prove cause across similar paths with feasible recurrence proof; symptoms or hypotheses block editing.

required_terms: Place business rules only in their owner
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Place business rules only in their owner or necessary structure after reuse fails.
- Stop on unresolved placement or dependency direction.

required_terms: Never widen public APIs only for tests
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Never widen public APIs only for tests.
- Make the smallest complete change, excluding unrelated refactors, duplicate helpers, needless dependencies, and untargeted contracts.
- Choose one batch method: test-first/test-after/existing-proof-only/non-test-validation.
- Require test-first for high risk, reproducible bugs, or review findings.
- Red means absent target behavior, never environment/fixture/import/syntax/unrelated failure.
- Preserve oracle, assertion strength, and derived risk during validation.
- Reserve test-after for low-risk local work or primary coverage.
- Existing-proof-only requires covered behavior, a regression mechanism, and fresh post-edit rerun.
- Non-test-validation is only for docs/comments/formatting/generated-sync/static-config/schema/build changes.
- Source/test/fixture/schema/config/generated-artifact/validation-command edits invalidate evidence.
- Rerun after latest material edit as current task-agent evidence with `latest-material-edit`/`validation-passed` Claims.
- Report skipped/flaky/retried/partial/unavailable/not-run.
- Lint/types/builds/coverage/manual checks/full-suite alone never prove changed behavior.

review_discipline_contract.applies_to: every implementation or repair review at L1-L5

handoff_projection_fields: Latest Actual Diff or Accessible Reference

required_terms: Apply Core review discipline at L1-L5
Level may add depth, independence, or evidence only
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Apply Core review discipline at L1-L5 to the actual latest diff and every changed file. Cover observable acceptance, validation freshness, regression mechanism, negative and boundary behavior, ownership and placement, unnecessary scope, unverified scope, and residual risk. Level may add depth, independence, or evidence only; it never removes a base dimension.

required_terms: named-specialist delegation with scope and reason
No Level may omit a dimension
profile_projection.exact_rule: - For every assigned Review Skill, decide all Core professional-risk dimensions. Use verified, finding, source-backed not-applicable, named-specialist delegation with scope and reason, or blocked. No Level may omit a dimension.

required_terms: Older review cannot cover the new modification
profile_projection.exact_rule: - After repair, require fresh validation, then the latest actual diff, then fresh re-review; invalidate only affected evidence, and a covering re-review satisfies final review. Older review cannot cover the new modification.

required_terms: Review or Risk Boundary sets frequency
Task completion is not a Review Boundary
Intermediate Review exists only when delay materially increases downstream material risk
categories alone do not create a Review Boundary
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Effective Level sets review depth; the Review or Risk Boundary sets frequency, and Task completion is not a Review Boundary. Intermediate Review exists only when delay materially increases downstream material risk; security, migration, or concurrency categories alone do not create a Review Boundary. A same-or-stronger current independent review subsumes weaker equivalent obligations only when required Review Skills and unique Specialist obligations remain covered.

- Reuse fresh, scope-correct, trustworthy-oracle validation evidence. Rerun only when stale, gapped, suspicious, flaky, environment-sensitive, under concrete doubt, or when Level or professional risk requires independent reproduction.

required_terms: Acceptance, correctness, invariant, regression, security, reliability, or material code health
Adjacent, optional, style, speculative, unrelated, or future work
PASS requires full required changed-scope review
profile_projection.exact_rule: - Only material current-task findings affecting Acceptance, correctness, invariant, regression, security, reliability, or material code health require repair. Adjacent, optional, style, speculative, unrelated, or future work does not. A fundamental failure may fail-fast blocked with Reviewed and Unreviewed Scope; PASS requires full required changed-scope review.

required_terms: named registered Review Skill, scope, and reason
invalidate only Evidence whose Scope intersects the repair
A covering scoped re-review satisfies Final Review
